explanation.summary: DYRUD ELEKTRO AS (981 072 316), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 1999-08-31; address Industrivegen 8, 3840 SELJORD, Norge. Main industry is 43.210 Elektrisk installasjonsarbeid; 23 registered employees; 1 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Espen Dyrud; Board chair: Morten Olav Dyrud; Auditor: REVISORTEAM TINN OG VEST-TELEMARK AS. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 44.88 m, operating profit NOK 2.14 m, net profit NOK 1.96 m, equity NOK 13.12 m, total assets NOK 27.39 m.
